scope: Four fixed order-1 representative cases derived from Gate 2; driven sweep extended to 4, 5, 6 GHz identically on both platforms
comparison_rule: abs(candidate-reference) <= absolute + relative * max(abs(candidate), abs(reference)); complex values use complex magnitude of the difference
identity_requirements: Identical input mesh SHA256 and canonical configuration SHA256
One MPI rank; one OpenMP/BLAS thread; CPU /cpu/self/opt/blocked
MPI, Hypre, METIS, MUMPS PORD/METIS, ARPACK/PARPACK enabled; no ParMETIS in either path
Identical pinned solver/dependency source revisions where used; LP64 numerical interfaces
Same solver, explicit METIS ordering where applicable and input tolerances
Compiler, MPI and BLAS implementation differences recorded as platform/toolchain differences

electrostatic.matrix: complete terminal-C.csv in farads, matched by row/column labels
invariants: quadratic energies for every coordinate vector and all-ones/alternating-sign vectors
electrostatic.invariant_absolute_scaling: trace: n; Frobenius norm: n; quadratic energy: square of vector 1-norm
electrostatic.physical_checks: positive diagonal and quadratic energies; reciprocity within the same entrywise absolute/relative tolerance

magnetostatic.matrix: complete terminal-M.csv inductance matrix in henries, matched by row/column labels
invariants: quadratic energies for every coordinate vector and all-ones/alternating-sign vectors
magnetostatic.invariant_absolute_scaling: trace: n; Frobenius norm: n; quadratic energy: square of vector 1-norm
magnetostatic.physical_checks: positive diagonal and quadratic energies; reciprocity within the same entrywise absolute/relative tolerance

driven.metric: all complex S[i][j] at all tested frequencies, reconstructed from dB magnitude and phase in degrees

eigenmode.matching: ascending real eigenfrequency; no raw eigenvector equality, sign or phase criterion

outputs: Both paths must have finite physical metrics/VTU data and valid VTK references; Q may be infinite only for exactly zero imaginary eigenfrequency. Byte-identical files and field-vector equality are not required.
failure_policy: Investigate discrepancies; never widen these limits after seeing results without an explicit documented acceptance change
